visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Functions Run in the Wrong Order
visualizerParams.problemDescription: compose(twice, addOne)(5) should print 12 (add one, then double), but the program prints 11.

solution.explanation: Composition follows maths notation: f(g(x)) applies g first. Swapping them applies f first, which gives a different result whenever the two operations do not commute (2 * (5 + 1) is not (2 * 5) + 1).
